install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/playwright"; if [ ! -d "$HOME/.local/playwright/node_modules/playwright" ]; then PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 npm --prefix "$HOME/.local/playwright" install --no-audit --no-fund playwright; fi; grep -qxF 'export NODE_PATH="$HOME/.local/playwright/node_modules${NODE_PATH:+:$NODE_PATH}"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export NODE_PATH="$HOME/.local/playwright/node_modules${NODE_PATH:+:$NODE_PATH}"' >> ~/.bashrc; if [ -x /usr/bin/google-chrome ]; then grep -qxF 'export CHROMIUM_PATH="/usr/bin/google-chrome"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export CHROMIUM_PATH="/usr/bin/google-chrome"' >> ~/.bashrc; fi
